title: How to use a custom webpack version in Next.js
nav_title: Custom Webpack
description: Use your application's webpack installation with Next.js instead of the bundled version.
uses the webpack version bundled with Next.js. To use webpack installed in your application instead, install webpack in your application and pass
. Run the development and production commands separately;

pnpm add -D webpack@^5.98.0
pnpm next dev --custom-webpack
pnpm next build --custom-webpack

npm install -D webpack@^5.98.0
npx next dev --custom-webpack
npx next build --custom-webpack

yarn add -D webpack@^5.98.0
yarn next dev --custom-webpack
yarn next build --custom-webpack

bun add -D webpack@^5.98.0
bunx next dev --custom-webpack
bunx next build --custom-webpack
Use a custom webpack version at your own risk.
Next.js does not validate the installed webpack version, and compatibility with other versions is not guaranteed. The examples use
; this feature is tested with webpack 5.98.0 and 5.111.0.
Run the install command from your application's directory. The custom version is available when Next.js evaluates
, so your webpack configuration and plugins can import it. If webpack is not installed in the application,
